The '''Dagro system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dagro]].
